acceptance_rule: daily_report_and_quant_signals_broker_performance_visibility: before absent; after identical validated summary in both outputs; fixture cash-PnL less each order fee once reconciles; incomplete/corrupt facts explicitly unavailable; source ledger and trading outputs unchanged

hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: Make committed broker closed-lifecycle trading PnL and latest reported order fees visible in daily outputs without changing trading behavior or historical evidence.

measurement_contract.acceptance: actual committed broker summary computed twice identically; raw source file hashes unchanged; same evaluated cohort gross minus order fees equals net; identical summary enters actual daily output statements without signal changes; missing/corrupt evidence explicitly unavailable
measurement_contract.production_impact: read-only measurement and reporting only; signals/rank/sizing/exits/cost assumptions/trade permissions unchanged

in_flight_duplicate_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §7 并发重复 reserve: the novelty gate cannot see in-flight tickets, so reservation re-checks open proposed/claimed/running tickets from the last 7 days and blocks fingerprint near-duplicates (score >= 0.65). Coordinate via scripts/list_experiments.py and scripts/agent_mailbox.py instead of racing.

nearest.reopen_condition: A valid retry needs materially richer PIT semantic provenance, such as extracted backlog growth rate, book-to-bill magnitude, contract duration/funding certainty, named customer importance, or forward replacement-value rows from a shared daily helper.

A separate consumer experiment may evaluate exit-side live drift on the 87 trusted closed lifecycles. A ledger/lifecycle revision requires verified broker timezone or push-event semantics, corporate-action/transfer records, a demonstrated cross-zero allocation contract, per-collection commit/visibility proof, or cursor-based cash-flow backfill evidence.
Closed cash/SPY/QQQ replacement-value outcomes for these structured events, or an LLM scorer that writes the same actor/object/relation/magnitude/evidence schema at decision time.

Consumption path for the opened numeric gate: run the frozen outcome-blind D0-D3 discovery scope on the estimate-revision surface (docs/alpha_search_phase1_handoff.md contract) in the next work unit; the scope must select a candidate for phase 2 to reopen. Machine trigger artifact: data/reopen_readiness.json phase2_estimate_revision status=ready (first ready 2026-08-28T16:47Z).
A future alpha iteration needs automatically accumulated settled forward rows, a distinct gate shape, or a new data source; this measurement repair alone is not alpha evidence.

observed_only_streak_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 forward-row attribution: after 3 consecutive observed-only closes on one data_source population, a further observed-only probe needs materially more settled rows, a new data source, or a new gate shape.

recipe_lane_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 排名/枚举清单消费: consuming a ranked list or finite taxonomy with one fixed evaluation recipe, one item per ID, is loop unrolling — not new evidence. After the lane triggers, only a single pooled batch (once) or park is legal. Curated lanes: docs/recipe_lanes.jsonl.

reopen_condition_guard.rule: If a parked surface has a quantitative reopen_condition, alpha-lane reservations that target that surface are blocked until the numeric reopen checks pass, unless the ticket names a genuinely new data source or a new gate shape.

routine_materialization_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 routine delta materialization: after 3 routine forward-ledger materialization IDs (one concrete surface, or same-shape across surfaces within 7 days), wire the materialization into run.py / the settlement pipeline once instead of reserving further manual IDs. Fault recovery is exempt.

saturated_source_axis.rule: For saturated (gate_shape, data_source) cells, legal override axes are limited to a new data source, a new gate shape, or materially more closed/settled forward rows. Same-source new fields/tags do not qualify.

registry_write_boundary: Standard close helper may update only this experiment entry in derived registry under lock; no direct registry edits.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not select profitable ticker, sector or time buckets from this account history and call them alpha; do not substitute missing fees or unknown starting positions with zero.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A demonstrated accounting defect with a reproducer, or independently frozen decision-order-fill lineage for a new strategy-attribution consumer.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The broker already held useful execution facts but daily reports used a separate missing trade diary. A strict committed-ledger consumer makes a covered negative trading sample visible without changing the source or selecting rules from its outcomes.
